title: Deer wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Deer body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="22" ry="15" fill="#C68E4E"/>
  <!-- Deer neck -->
  <rect x="42" y="55" width="16" height="25" rx="7" fill="#D4A05A"/>
  <!-- Deer head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="18" ry="16" fill="#D4A05A"/>
  <!-- Deer muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#E8C08A"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#3A2A1A"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="46" r="3" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="46" r="3" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="45" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="45" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="38" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#D4A05A" transform="rotate(-20 32 38)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="38" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#D4A05A" transform="rotate(20 68 38)"/>
  <!-- Inner ears -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="38" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#E8A0A0" transform="rotate(-20 32 38)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="38" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#E8A0A0" transform="rotate(20 68 38)"/>
  <!-- Antlers -->
  <path d="M40 34 L34 20 L30 24 M34 20 L28 16" stroke="#8B6B3E" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 34 L66 20 L70 24 M66 20 L72 16" stroke="#8B6B3E" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points="50,20 38,42 62,42" fill="#E84393"/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <polygon points="43,34 48,24 53,34" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <polygon points="45,38 50,30 55,38" fill="#6C5CE7"/>
  <!-- Hat pompom -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="19" r="4" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <!-- Hat brim band -->
  <rect x="38" y="41" width="24" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <!-- Front legs -->
  <rect x="36" y="88" width="6" height="10" rx="3" fill="#C68E4E"/>
  <rect x="58" y="88" width="6" height="10" rx="3" fill="#C68E4E"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x="36" y="95" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#3A2A1A"/>
  <rect x="58" y="95" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#3A2A1A"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="76" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#E8C08A"/>
</svg>
